name: Odd Family
overview: A traffic accident claimed the lives of seven members of a family and left only Thanh My alive. Thanh, their only remaining relative, tried to treat her, but she didn't recognize him and had completely lost her memory. Kim, Thanh's girlfriend, proposed creating a rental family so that Thanh My could live in a happy and familiar environment so as to help her quickly regain her memory without causing her further trauma.
